component.name: Plemmo EPOS
component.summary: Offline-first EPOS for hospitality and retail

description.p: Plemmo EPOS is an offline-first Point of Sale platform for both hospitality businesses (restaurants, cafes, takeaways) and retail businesses (shops, electronics, grocery). It runs entirely on your own machine with no internet required. Derived from the FloCafe project under the MIT licence.

ul.li: Fast order entry with multiple order types (dine-in, takeaway, delivery)
Kitchen Display System (KDS) with real-time updates
Thermal receipt printing via ESC/POS (USB and network)
Works offline — no subscriptions or cloud dependency

description.p: Multi-arch Linux distribution publishing: snap-store + AppImageHub auto-discovery + arm64 AppImage, deb, rpm, snap. Migrated snap config to core24 + GNOME extension. Fixed strict-confinement plug list (network-bind, screen-inhibit-control). Release history after this point is appended automatically by `scripts/update-metainfo.js` at release time.

Fixed: Paying a prepaid order in full marks it completed immediately. Standalone KDS item status changes broadcast live over WebSockets. Removed unused customer deletion endpoint. Added keep-me-logged-in option, payment method breakdown in dashboard, and cart editing improvements.
Latest release with Linux improvements and bug fixes.
